greeting: Regent Caelum on comms. Stage 2: The Regent's Revelation. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Shattered Light. Objective drift gets teams buried.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Present your case to Regent Caelum.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Present your case to Regent Caelum; Submit to the Truth Prism; Reveal your true intentions. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Meet with Regent Caelum and learn of the Crystal of Truth. Immediate move: Present your case to Regent Caelum.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: The Regent's Revelation. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Mirror of the Soul.
rumor: A shattered lens was heard chanting the same warning in seven languages.
People keep repeating one clue from The Regent's Revelation: 'Reveal your true intentions'.
The walls keep whispering patch notes. I only trust the ones with timestamps.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn light in Prism reveals hidden seams in mirrored stone.
dialog.time_noon: Noon overcharges reflection grids. Angle your approach, do not rush centerline.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk doubles your silhouette count. Track teammate positions verbally.
dialog.time_night: Night turns crystal caverns into echo mazes. Keep line-of-sight discipline.

party_reactions.kade: Regent Caelum sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Regent Caelum accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Regent Caelum talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
